out.description: Absolute output path for the animated .glb (may equal path)

preset.description: idle | bob | spin | sway | breathe | hop

duration.description: Loop length in seconds (default per preset: idle 4, bob 3, spin 6, sway 3, breathe 4, hop 1.2)

amplitude.description: Scales every displacement and angle; 1 = a few % of the height / a few degrees

name.description: Clip name (default: the preset); an existing clip of this name is replaced

preview.description: Rendered PNG of the animated asset (rest pose) returned with the result: thumbnail (one 3/4 view) | turntable (4 angles tiled 2x2) | none

render.description: Checkpoint render: true = attach a thumbnail even if preview=none, false = no image (overrides preview)

dry_run.description: Compute everything in memory and return the diff it would apply; write nothing
